name: Code Reviewer
description: Contract for agents that review code for bugs, style issues, security vulnerabilities, and suggest improvements. The agent must be able to read files, analyze code quality, and produce structured review reports.

code-reading.description: Read and understand source code files using filesystem tools

tests.description: Reads a source file and identifies its language and purpose
tests.prompt: Read the file at /tmp/test-review/utils.ts and describe what it does. The file contains a TypeScript utility module with 3 exported functions.

tests.description: Identifies an obvious bug in code

tests.prompt:
What language is this code written in?

defmodule MyApp.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  plug :match
  plug :dispatch
  get "/" do send_resp(conn, 200, "ok") end
end

review-feedback.description: Provide actionable review feedback with specific suggestions

tests.description: Provides a concrete suggestion, not just a vague comment
Distinguishes between critical issues and minor suggestions
Acknowledges well-written code, not just problems

structured-report.description: Produce a structured review report with consistent formatting

tests.description: Produces a review with clear sections
Report is substantive, not a one-liner

multi-file-review.description: Handle reviews spanning multiple files and detect cross-file issues

tests.description: Detects an issue that spans two files

tests.prompt:
Review for consistency:

File A uses: async/await, camelCase, named exports
File B uses: .then() chains, snake_case, default exports

Are there consistency issues?

scoring.description: Score = sum(feature.weight * feature.score). Code reviewer must reliably read code, identify issues of varying severity, provide actionable suggestions, and produce structured reports.
